note: Publications by other bodies that cite asylumstats.co.uk as a source. Each entry is read from the publication's own text, not a summary. nameUsed is the spelling the publication gives the site; linked says whether it links to the site. A copy of the same piece carried by another outlet goes under alsoIn, not as a separate citation. checked is the date the cited figures were compared with the site's data. No byline: the record names outlets, not individuals.

citations.title: The UK city on the brink of refusing to accept any more asylum seekers
citations.location: the paragraph after the Migration Observatory figures, near the end of the article
citations.used: Sunderland's rate of people on asylum support per 10,000 residents, its rank against the rest of the country, and the number of people on asylum support in the city
citations.checkedNote: All three figures match the Home Office local authority data for 30 June 2026 shown on the site: 823 people on asylum support, 28.7 per 10,000 residents (the article gives it unrounded, as 28.67), a higher rate than 322 of 361 local authorities (89%).
